reading: Pocket Diary, Lit (7.57 linked in 14a, +0.16 on Joined, 0 promise votes) is liked for what it alone has: one steel line of time that runs down every page with ringed lamps (a lit Now lamp, a Next ring that breathes), every date set as a diary sets a day (a big light numeral beside a stacked month and weekday, on slate tabs), Plans as diary weeks beside a little lit month on glass ("the best new graphic in the heat"), the pulse trace in the Next tube (soul, style), To do's quick-add (usability: the fastest add in the heat), Joined's meter with its tabular ledger on Status, and its light rule: the machine's words glow and the family's stay matte. Four faults sank it, and every lens named at least one of them. (1) Home's right column is three boxed main-camp cards with dead ground under them, in a design whose idea is no boxes (feedback, soul, style, system, skeptic; the cross lessons call it pasted). (2) "Later" sits beside "Lately added" and stutters (soul, style, interaction, type, usability, feedback). (3) On the phone the next plan falls below the fold, the box is tall, and the bar hides Memory, Family, Status and Settings behind "More" (system, interaction, usability, skeptic). (4) Amber rings run down the line like a warning column, the rings are many and small, the type is about 13px, and "4 open · 3 late" floats far from its title (skeptic, soul, type). The title "What can we pencil in?" is retired: it sounds tentative and calendar-only, and its lit word sits mid-line. To win, the line has to become the clearest frame-over-grammar page in the field. Every heat's top two joined a main-camp frame to a tour grammar. Here that means Home rebuilt as a diary spread with no boxes and no empty ground, a lit run wired from the tube to the row it reports, the line ending in a status foot and not in empty space, the back pages filling the bottom, and the phone putting the next plan on the first screen. Pocket must also keep its own signatures (the diary dates, square stops and pulses, the steel line), because the field is converging on rails with NOW lamps and ring setup strips.

briefs.name: Pocket Diary, Bound
briefs.hypothesis: The carried cross lost points almost entirely to structure, not to its idea: boxed cards on the right with dead ground under them, a stuttering Later head, the next plan below the phone's fold, and amber rings down the line. This brief keeps every device the judges praised (the steel line with a lit Now lamp and breathing Next ring, diary-set dates, the glass month on Plans, the pulse trace, the quick-add, the machine-lit and family-matte light rule, the Status meter and ledger). It rebuilds Home as a bound diary spread with no boxes and no empty ground, and it takes the main camp's three proven frames in Pocket's own terms: Desk's lit patch lead becomes the diary's lit run from the tube to the Next row, Plate's status foot becomes the line's last stop on every page, and Folio's two-tier household becomes the diary's back pages. Those are the moves that won heats in 14a: a frame joined to a grammar, light wired to what it reports, and empty ground filled with content rather than stretched. A ribbon bookmark for 'here' and a new diary-voiced title keep it unmistakably Pocket's, so it does not converge on the field.
briefs.brief:
Start from x14a-pocket-cross (copy palettes/x14a-pocket-cross.json and variants/x14a-pocket-cross/). Keep the slate ground, the steel line (2px, var(--edge) #5d6a72), condensed Instrument Sans heads, Plex Sans body, Plex Mono figures only, diary-set dates, the Next tube's pulse trace, the glass month, Vera's lit chat screens, the Status meter with its ledger, and To do's quick-add. The sheet is at 194.8K of 200K, so first delete the dead layers: .shelf, .shelf-stub, .panel.leaf / .home-todo / .home-wishes / .home-eat, the footer key, the successive grid-template-columns on the day tab (keep one), and the radar inside .next-up. Aim for 170K or less before adding rules.

HOME, desktop (1280): a bound spread inside a 1160px container. The main line runs at x≈90 as now. Stops are rings on the line: Now (lit lamp), Next (breathing ring), Due, Later. Stop words are set as small text in the line (Plex Sans 13px, var(--label)), never beside a section heading.
Row A, two pages (grid 1fr 380px, gap 48px). Left page: the Now stop with Vera's tab and the box (greeting title, textarea, the From/mic/Send row), then the three starters on one row. Right page: the Next up tube at the box's height (about 250px): NEXT UP plate, the plan title, 'Sun 4 Oct · 13:00 [in 2 days]', '› 3 more on the line', and the four-week pulse trace run across the tube's full width with day numerals under the pulses. Drop the radar circle, so the trace is the tube's one figure and Pocket stops sharing the field's radar. Under the tube, the setup as one line hung from a short amber tick: 'Finish setting up 3 · Choose your own password →', with 'All 3 steps' at the right. This replaces the setup stop on the main line, so plans come up the page.
Row B, full width: Next, which is Coming up. The heading 'Coming up' sits in a rule head (title in the rule's break), with '4 plans · All plans →' on its baseline. Rows are diary-set: tab, time, entry, how far off. Lighten the tabs: no slate fill, only a 1px left hairline, with the 28px light numeral and the stacked Oct/Sun carrying the row. The first row is the Next row: its ring is the Next ring and its 'in 2 days' readout glows dim phosphor. THE LIT RUN (graft 1): the main line is lit #6dff9c, with the kit's line halo (box-shadow 0 0 4px #6dff9c80, 0 0 12px #6dff9c33), only from the Now lamp down to the Next ring; after the Next ring it is steel. A socket (a 10px ring) sits on the tube's bottom bezel, right of centre. From it a 2px lit lead drops straight down, under 48px, through the row gap onto the Next row's right end at its readout. So the tube is wired to the row it reports and nothing else on the page glows on that path. The 'Google Calendar is not connected' note goes under the rows at 14px.
Row C, two pages again (1fr 380px). Left page, on the main line: the Due stop, To do. Rule head 'Things to do', with '4 open · 3 late' on the title's baseline right after it, not at the far edge. Then the quick-add ('What needs doing…' plus Add, as on the To do page). Then rows: due tab, steel-outlined square tick (1.5px var(--edge), never amber), title, a person glyph and plain name (no chip), and amber words 'was due 5 days ago'. Late is ONE amber half-lamp ring at the head of the late group, labelled '3 late'. The late rows' own rings are steel. A short lit Now rule cuts late from undated, and 'No date' stays in the tab. Right page, unboxed under rule heads with no panels or edges: 'The kids' wishes' (Maya 0 open, Theo 0 open, each with a gift glyph) and 'Something to eat' (Pho Oregon, for anyone, with its restaurant well; '2 to try →'). Size this column to end level with To do. If it runs short, list the second restaurant rather than stretching anything.
Row D, full width, on the main line: the Later ring, with the word 'Later' small in the line, and the heading 'Lately added' alone (rule head; '12 ideas · + Add an idea · All 12 →' on the baseline). Rows: kind well (keep the muted terracotta, sage and steel-blue wells), title, kind, for whom, #n, set as a tabular row with the 'for' column brought in beside the titles.
Row E, full width: THE BACK PAGES (graft 3). Head: 'At the back' in a rule head. Then four equal cells divided by 1px vertical hairlines, no boxes, each two-tier: the name as a 19px condensed head with its icon (Memory, Family, Status, Settings), and under it one fact in 15px ink-2 (Memory: 'Tell Vera something →'; Family: 'Sam · Alex · Maya · Theo'; Status: '1 of 3 on' with three tiny lamps; Settings: '9 parts'). Each cell carries a 6px-tall thumb-index tab on its top edge in a grounded low-chroma colour: sage #8fa58c, steel-blue #7f9bb5, wheat #c9b27e, slate-lilac #9a93b8. These hues replace the amber rings' colour, so the page does not drain toward green.
FOOT TERMINUS (graft 2): on EVERY page the main line ends, and does not trail off, at a last stop just above the footer. A lamp sits on the line (lit #6dff9c when ready, amber half-lamp while a trouble goes on), with one line in 14px: 'Ready · OpenAI gpt-6-luna · $0.00 of $2.00 today' (model in Plex Mono) and 'Status →' at the right. Remove the dotted Later tail.

HOME, phone (390): the bar keeps the mark plus four 44px icon keys at the top right (Memory, Family, Status, Settings) with aria-labels. Delete the 'More' menu. The bottom tab strip stays (Home, Vera, Ideas, Plans, To do, Wishes). Order: box, then the Next up tube, then starters, setup line, Coming up, To do, wishes, eat, Lately added, back pages (2×2), foot terminus. Shorten the box: placeholder 'A plan, an idea, a reminder…' on one line (rows=2); From, mic and Send on one row; 'Send where I am' becomes a 44px crosshair toggle with a visible short label 'Where I am' (still a real checkbox in a label, so it works with scripts off). The tube's NEXT UP and plan title must sit above y=700 of 844. The title uses text-wrap: balance.

TYPE: raise every step by one. Body and row titles go to 16px/1.5 (from about 13-15). Meta and labels go to 14px, and the floor is 13px for stop words and legends only. Section rule heads are 24px condensed 600 in var(--heading) #dcd8cb. Page titles stay 44px condensed; the greeting title is 52px desktop and 36px phone. Diary numerals are Plex Sans 300 at 28px with tabular lining figures, the stacked month and weekday 11px Plex Mono, and the same setting on Home, Plans, To do and Chat day breaks. Counts sit on the title's baseline across all pages (To do, Status, Ideas).

RINGS: fewer and further apart. A ring only at a stop (14px) and on a dated row (10px), with no ring on undated rows, and at least 40px between rings. Stops are rings, never square plates. (The square tick stays for checkboxes only, so nodes are never confused with ticks.)

HERE (ledger L249): drop the current place's filled tile in the bar. Its label goes var(--heading) over a faint latched tint (rgba of steel, 8%), and a ribbon bookmark (10×20px, V-notched by clip-path: polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 100%,50% 72%,0 100%)) hangs from the bar's bottom edge under it, in muted oxblood #8c4f45. It is the diary's own ribbon: on the phone it hangs from the tab strip's top edge over the current tab. The 44px target stays on the label.

LIGHT (phosphor_kit.md, at the tube's strengths; light only where the machine speaks or where to press): the greeting's lit word with the kit's two-layer halo (text-shadow 0 0 2px #6dff9c, 0 0 10px #6dff9c99, 0 0 24px #6dff9c40). The tube's bloom, scanlines and blur stay as they are. The Now lamp is lit with the layered halo. The Next ring breathes (opacity .55↔1 over 3.2s; static under prefers-reduced-motion). The lit run and lead as above. Send and Add are lit from within, with light pooled under them. The box's prompt glows only on :focus-within; at rest the placeholder is matte var(--faint) and has no caret. Vera's chat lines stay small lit screens: the newest gets the rim plus bloom, older ones rim-only, and her body text halo is cut to 0 0 6px at 25% so 16px stays crisp. Row hover gets a 2px phosphor-green left edge afterglow fading over 400ms. Everything the family wrote stays matte.

OTHER PAGES: the same line, foot terminus and ribbon everywhere. To do: counts on the title's baseline, steel square ticks, one amber half-lamp at the late group, and the quick-add kept. Plans: diary weeks beside the glass month, unchanged except the lightened tabs and the raised type. Status: the meter's case thinned to a 2px bezel, the head figures on the title's baseline, the marks' key cut to one line under the head, and 'needs a look' as plain words with one amber half-lamp (no amber number). Ideas: the 'for' column brought beside the titles, and the kind index kept. Settings: the index tiles lose their boxes and become two-tier cells like the back pages (name head plus one fact, a thumb-index tab in the section's grounded hue). Section pages keep their hairline groups on the line. The form (new idea): the groups hang from the line at rings, and the fields keep plain square edges (no ring stops on fields: they read as radios).
briefs.borrows:
Judges' fixes (most cited first):
(1) Unbox Home's right column and leave no dead ground under it: feedback, soul, style, system and skeptic, plus the cross lessons' 'pasted' note. Done as Row C's unboxed right page sized to To do, Row A's tube-plus-setup page, and the full-width back pages.
(2) Rename 'Later / Lately added': soul, style, interaction, type, usability and feedback. 'Later' moves into the line as a stop word, and the heading is 'Lately added' alone.
(3) Phone: the next plan on the first screen, a shorter box, and the bar's icons instead of 'More': system, interaction, usability and skeptic.
(4) Late as one amber ring plus words, not a column of amber rings, and steel-outlined ticks: skeptic (14a), skeptic (landing).
(5) Raise the type a step: skeptic, type (landing). Counts on the title's baseline: type. text-wrap: balance on the title: type.
(6) Fewer, further-apart rings: soul, system ('one ring style'). Lighter Coming up tabs: interaction. Status meter bezel to 2px: system. Drop the second Next/tube from the left line and get plans up the page: usability.
(7) From tour round 3, still open: no lit caret in an empty box, the prompt glowing only on focus (soul, interaction, usability, type), a weaker body halo (type), and older Vera bubbles rim-only (soul).

Other camp's features:
(a) THE LIT RUN AND LEAD, from Desk Terminal, Patched (x14a-desk-cross): the patch lead from a socket on the case into Coming up's NOW lamp, which style, system and interaction called the best graft of heat a. Taken in the caveat's corrected form: longer (10×20), low-chroma oxblood not orchid, a heading-coloured label with a faint tint, the target on the label.

KEEPS: the steel line with Now lamp and breathing Next ring on every page, diary-set dates, the pulse trace, the glass month on Plans, the quick-add, the machine-lit and family-matte rule, Vera's lit chat screens, and the Status meter and ledger. TAKES: the lit run and lead, the foot terminus, the back pages, the ribbon. GIVES UP: the three boxed right-column cards and the sticky shelf, the radar in the Next tube, the setup stop on the main line (it moves under the tube), the column of amber rings, square stop plates, the 'More' menu on the phone, the footer key, the dotted Later tail, and the stale overridden sheet layers.
briefs.avoids: Boxed right column and dead ground under it (feedback, soul, style, system, skeptic): no panels anywhere on Home, the right page is sized to its neighbour, and the bottom is full-width content (Lately added, back pages, foot). 'Later Lately added' stutter (six lenses). The next plan below the phone's fold, the tall box and the 'More' menu (system, interaction, usability, skeptic). The amber warning column, amber-outlined ticks (skeptic), and many small rings (soul). About 13px type and counts floating from their titles (skeptic, type). A two-line title split mid-phrase (type). A lit caret or glowing prompt read as typed text (soul, interaction, usability, type). Too heavy a halo on body text (type). The cross lessons' warnings: no long right-angled wire across empty ground (Listing's failed reach), nothing stretched to fill space (Trued, Manual), and no ring-stops on form fields or ring-as-tick (Departures, Desk). Colour drain: the amber rings' share is replaced by named grounded hues (oxblood ribbon; sage, steel-blue, wheat and slate-lilac index tabs). Convergence: no radar, no ring setup strip, no shared title, and Pocket's own diary dates and ribbon kept as signatures.
briefs.title: Jot it down for Vera to *plan*. The diary's own verb ('jot') makes the box a place to write anything down (a weekend, a reminder, an idea, a wish), not only tentative calendar entries, which was 'pencil in''s fault for interaction, usability, system and the skeptic. It names who hears you (Vera), as the favoured 'Give Vera something to plan.' does. It is an invitation that cannot be answered 'no', and it puts the one short lit word, 'plan', last, as the cross lessons asked for Pocket ('the diary voice with the lit word last'), with the full stop outside the glow. It has not been tried by any design, so it widens the search. On the phone it sets on two balanced lines, 'Jot it down / for Vera to plan.'
